chansons.style: Heavy metal festival anthem, palm muted riffs, double kick drums, roaring male vocals, crowd chants, 142 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un hymne de festival où la foule devient une armée sous les projecteurs.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Feedback scream)
Yeah!
Raise your fists!

[Verse 1]
Ten thousand bodies crashing under neon skies
Amplifiers howling where the black flag flies
Boots on the gravel, sweat upon the steel
Tonight we’re worshiping the god we feel

[Pre-Chorus]
The stage is burning, the speakers bleed
We are the hunger, we are the need

[Chorus]
Moshpit kings, we own the night
Fists in the air, we ignite
Moshpit kings, hear the roar
One loud tribe, forevermore!

[Verse 2]
Strangers turn brothers when the first chord strikes
Leather and thunder rolling through the dikes
Bassline earthquake shaking every bone
We found a kingdom we can call our own

[Pre-Chorus]
The stage is burning, the speakers bleed
We are the hunger, we are the need

[Chorus]
Moshpit kings, we own the night
Fists in the air, we ignite
Moshpit kings, hear the roar
One loud tribe, forevermore!

[Bridge]
Circle pit! (Circle pit!)
Wall of death! (Wall of death!)
Scream it loud until your final breath!

[Chorus]
Moshpit kings, we own the night
Fists in the air, we ignite
Moshpit kings, hear the roar
One loud tribe, forevermore!

[Outro]
Forevermore!
Moshpit kings!
Yeah!

chansons.style: Melodic hard rock, driving palm muted riffs, double bass drums, gritty powerful vocals, hopeful edge, 150 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un guerrier brisé brûle son passé pour renaître plus fort.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Clean guitar swell)
Let it burn...

[Verse 1]
I buried yesterday beneath a rusted cross
Counted every failure, tallied every loss
The mirror showed a stranger with hollow tired eyes
So I struck the match and watched the old man die

[Pre-Chorus]
No more chains, no more names
I’m walking out the flames

[Chorus]
Ashes to arise, I’m rising from the dust
Shatter every vow, break the iron rust
Ashes to arise, a brand new beating heart
This is where the ending turns into the start

[Verse 2]
The highway stretches open like a sharpened blade
Every mile a promise that I finally made
Left the ghosts behind me at the county line
Now the wind is screaming and the sun is mine

[Pre-Chorus]
No more chains, no more names
I’m walking out the flames

[Chorus]
Ashes to arise, I’m rising from the dust
Shatter every vow, break the iron rust
Ashes to arise, a brand new beating heart
This is where the ending turns into the start

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Burn it down, build it high
Phoenix wings across the sky
I am born again tonight!

[Chorus]
Ashes to arise, I’m rising from the dust
Shatter every vow, break the iron rust
Ashes to arise, a brand new beating heart
This is where the ending turns into the start

[Outro]
Arise...
Arise!

chansons.titre_fr: La maison de la ceinture de rouille
chansons.style: Gritty heavy metal, chugging palm muted riffs, thunderous double kick, raw emotional vocals, industrial vibe, 158 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Ode sombre à une ville ouvrière qui a forgé l'âme du chanteur.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Factory siren)
Hometown...

[Verse 1]
Smokestack cathedrals where my father prayed
Iron in the water, debts we never paid
Main street boarded up but the memories still breathe
Every cracked sidewalk got a story underneath

[Pre-Chorus]
They call it dying, I call it home
Blood in the mortar, steel in the bone

[Chorus]
Rust Belt home, you raised me hard
Forged in the furnace, scarred by the yard
Rust Belt home, I wear your name
Through fire and failure, I stay the same

[Verse 2]
Friday night lights and the quarterback’s ghost
Diner coffee bitter like the things I miss the most
Mama’s porch still creaks when the north wind blows
This broken little city is the only truth I know

[Pre-Chorus]
They call it dying, I call it home
Blood in the mortar, steel in the bone

[Chorus]
Rust Belt home, you raised me hard
Forged in the furnace, scarred by the yard
Rust Belt home, I wear your name
Through fire and failure, I stay the same

[Bridge]
Let the skyline crumble, let the rivers run black
Every mile I wander, I keep coming back
Yeah, I keep coming back!

[Chorus]
Rust Belt home, you raised me hard
Forged in the furnace, scarred by the yard
Rust Belt home, I wear your name
Through fire and failure, I stay the same

[Outro]
Stay the same...
Hometown...

chansons.style: Power metal ballad turned heavy, palm muted verse riffs, explosive chorus, double kick, soaring vocals, 164 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Le souvenir brûlant d'un premier amour qui a marqué une vie entière.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Clean arpeggio)
I still remember...

[Verse 1]
Seventeen and trembling underneath the summer stars
Your laugh cut through the static of a thousand cheap guitars
We swore upon a cigarette we’d never fade away
You kissed me like a promise I still carry to this day

[Pre-Chorus]
Time stole the moment but it never stole the spark
You’re the only fire that still lights me in the dark

[Chorus]
First flame, you burned so bright
Scarred my soul in golden light
First flame, I still feel the heat
Every heartbeat, bittersweet

[Verse 2]
Letters in a shoebox, photographs of who we were
Two kids against the world before the world began to blur
I married someone kinder but I dream in your design
Some loves don’t ever leave you, they just bide their time

[Pre-Chorus]
Time stole the moment but it never stole the spark
You’re the only fire that still lights me in the dark

[Chorus]
First flame, you burned so bright
Scarred my soul in golden light
First flame, I still feel the heat
Every heartbeat, bittersweet

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
If I saw you tomorrow on some crowded avenue
Would you recognize the boy who gave his soul to you?

[Chorus]
First flame, you burned so bright
Scarred my soul in golden light
First flame, I still feel the heat
Every heartbeat, bittersweet

[Outro]
Bittersweet...
First flame...

chansons.style: Doom-tinged heavy metal, slow palm muted chugs, mournful leads, deep powerful vocals, double kick bursts, 145 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un exilé chante la douleur d'une patrie qu'il ne reverra peut-être jamais.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Distant duduk-like lead)
Far from home...

[Verse 1]
Strange tongues on every corner, strange faces in the crowd
I walk a foreign pavement but my heart is screaming loud
The mountains of my childhood are a photograph I keep
And every night I taste the dust of promises I weep

[Pre-Chorus]
Borders cut the body but they cannot cut the soul
Half of me is buried where the ancient rivers roll

[Chorus]
Exile’s lament, I carry you inside
Homeland of my fathers, my compass and my pride
Exile’s lament, the miles cannot erase
I see my mother’s kitchen every time I close my eyes

[Verse 2]
They gave me paper freedom and a cold and narrow bed
But paper cannot warm me like the words my grandfather said
I learn their rigid language, I wear their quiet skin
But underneath the surface, the old songs still begin

[Pre-Chorus]
Borders cut the body but they cannot cut the soul
Half of me is buried where the ancient rivers roll

[Chorus]
Exile’s lament, I carry you inside
Homeland of my fathers, my compass and my pride
Exile’s lament, the miles cannot erase
I see my mother’s kitchen every time I close my eyes

[Bridge]
One day I’ll cross the water
One day I’ll kiss the stone
Until that day I wander
But I will not die alone!

[Chorus]
Exile’s lament, I carry you inside
Homeland of my fathers, my compass and my pride
Exile’s lament, the miles cannot erase
I see my mother’s kitchen every time I close my eyes

[Outro]
Take me home...
Take me home...

chansons.style: Speed heavy metal, fast palm muted gallop, relentless double kick, aggressive vocals, anthemic chorus, 176 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un cri de guerre contre toutes les chaînes, physiques ou mentales.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Drum fill explosion)
Break free!

[Verse 1]
They built a cage of opinions and they called it common sense
They drew a little circle and they called it a defense
But I tasted something wilder than their comfortable lies
I saw the open heaven through a rebel’s burning eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
No master, no collar, no throne above my head
I’d rather die standing than live among the dead

[Chorus]
Unchained thunder, hear me roar!
Kick down the ceiling, break down the door
Unchained thunder, wild and free
Nobody’s shadow over me!

[Verse 2]
They wrote me up a script and they told me every line
Said stay inside the margins and you’ll turn out doing fine
But margins are for cowards who are terrified to bleed
I’m writing my own gospel with the fire that I need

[Pre-Chorus]
No master, no collar, no throne above my head
I’d rather die standing than live among the dead

[Chorus]
Unchained thunder, hear me roar!
Kick down the ceiling, break down the door
Unchained thunder, wild and free
Nobody’s shadow over me!

[Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
Run! Run! Run!
Into the sun!
Nothing can hold me,
My life has begun!

[Chorus]
Unchained thunder, hear me roar!
Kick down the ceiling, break down the door
Unchained thunder, wild and free
Nobody’s shadow over me!

[Outro]
Over me!
Free!
Free!

chansons.style: Anthemic heavy metal, marching palm muted riffs, war drums, double kick, triumphant choir-backed vocals, 170 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un champion célèbre sa victoire durement conquise sur l'adversité.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(War horns)
Rise!

[Verse 1]
They said I’d never make it past the seventh round
They laughed at every stumble, cheered me to the ground
But every bruise was iron, every scar was steel
And now I’m standing taller than the doubt they made me feel

[Pre-Chorus]
The bell has rung, the battle’s done
I look into the rising sun

[Chorus]
Iron crown upon my brow
I earned it, I own it, here and now
Iron crown, I paid the cost
Victory rises from the lost!

[Verse 2]
Twelve long years of silence in a cold and empty gym
While the world was sleeping I was learning how to win
Now the stadium is chanting every syllable I breathe
And every ghost that mocked me is the dust beneath my feet

[Pre-Chorus]
The bell has rung, the battle’s done
I look into the rising sun

[Chorus]
Iron crown upon my brow
I earned it, I own it, here and now
Iron crown, I paid the cost
Victory rises from the lost!

[Bridge]
Hold it high!
Hold it high!
Let the banners touch the sky!
We are kings tonight!

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
Iron crown upon my brow
I earned it, I own it, here and now
Iron crown, I paid the cost
Victory rises from the lost!

[Outro]
Victory!
Iron crown!
Yeah!

chansons.style: Nautical heavy metal, rolling palm muted riffs, crashing cymbals, double kick, deep commanding vocals, 152 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: La mer est dépeinte comme une déesse ancienne, belle et impitoyable.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Wave crash, foghorn)
She calls...

[Verse 1]
Salt upon my tongue and the horizon in my veins
She has drowned a thousand sailors but she knows me by my name
Her laughter is the tempest, her whisper is the tide
And every man who loves her has already nearly died

[Pre-Chorus]
She gives and she takes, she heals and she breaks
The queen of the deep with a thousand shipwrecked wakes

[Chorus]
Tides of wrath, pull me down
Wear the ocean like a crown
Tides of wrath, cold and deep
Secrets that the drowned men keep

[Verse 2]
The lighthouse is a liar with a yellow painted eye
It promises you safety while the reefs are waiting nigh
I’d rather sink in glory with the kraken by my side
Than rot upon the dry land where the timid choose to hide

[Pre-Chorus]
She gives and she takes, she heals and she breaks
The queen of the deep with a thousand shipwrecked wakes

[Chorus]
Tides of wrath, pull me down
Wear the ocean like a crown
Tides of wrath, cold and deep
Secrets that the drowned men keep

[Bridge]
Down! Down! Down!
To the palace of the drowned!
Where the ancient ones are sleeping
And no mercy can be found!

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
Tides of wrath, pull me down
Wear the ocean like a crown
Tides of wrath, cold and deep
Secrets that the drowned men keep

[Outro]
The deep...
The deep...

chansons.style: Atmospheric heavy metal, rain-soaked palm muted riffs, rolling double kick like rainfall, emotional gritty vocals, 168 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une tempête intérieure trouve son écho dans une pluie battante libératrice.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Rain ambience, thunder)
Let it fall...

[Verse 1]
Sky cracked open like a wound above the town
Every drop a hammer beating sorrow to the ground
I stood out on the rooftop with my face against the gray
Let the heavens wash the words I never learned to say

[Pre-Chorus]
No umbrella, no defense
Just a man and consequence

[Chorus]
Downpour, drown me clean
Wash away what might have been
Downpour, break the sky
Let me cry, let me cry

[Verse 2]
Gutters running rivers through the streets I used to know
Every memory dissolving in the silver undertow
Thunder is the sermon, lightning is the choir
And the rain becomes the only thing that doesn’t call me liar

[Pre-Chorus]
No umbrella, no defense
Just a man and consequence

[Chorus]
Downpour, drown me clean
Wash away what might have been
Downpour, break the sky
Let me cry, let me cry

[Bridge]
Pour it harder!
Pour it longer!
Make me softer!
Make me stronger!

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
Downpour, drown me clean
Wash away what might have been
Downpour, break the sky
Let me cry, let me cry

[Outro]
Let me cry...
Let it fall...

chansons.style: Aggressive thrash-tinged heavy metal, tight palm muted riffs, punishing double kick, snarling vocals, dark vibe, 160 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme trahi par son plus proche allié promet une vengeance glaciale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Dissonant riff)
You...

[Verse 1]
You sat across my table, drank the wine I poured for you
Swore upon my children that your word was always true
But I found the hidden letters and I saw the crooked smile
You were sharpening the dagger in the shadows all the while

[Pre-Chorus]
Brother turned to stranger, stranger turned to snake
How much more of me did you plan to take?

[Chorus]
Judas kiss upon my cheek
Burn the bridge, I’ll burn the creek
Judas kiss, the price is high
Watch me watch you watch me rise!

[Verse 2]
I won’t waste my fury on a sermon or a speech
I will let the silence be the lesson that I teach
Every door I opened you have bolted from inside
Now enjoy the empty kingdom where your rotten lies reside

[Pre-Chorus]
Brother turned to stranger, stranger turned to snake
How much more of me did you plan to take?

[Chorus]
Judas kiss upon my cheek
Burn the bridge, I’ll burn the creek
Judas kiss, the price is high
Watch me watch you watch me rise!

[Bridge]
Thirty silver pieces
Weren’t enough to buy my soul
Now you’re digging deeper
In the grave you thought you stole!

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
Judas kiss upon my cheek
Burn the bridge, I’ll burn the creek
Judas kiss, the price is high
Watch me watch you watch me rise!

[Outro]
Rise!
Rise!
Never again!
